# AMC Royal

<!-- Generated by tools/build-styles.mjs from style.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

**Universal Theme style** · light · built on vita · APEX 23.1+ · v1.0.0

A formal government and enterprise style: a deep indigo header with a thin gold rule, a warm ivory page, ivory-white regions, an indigo primary, and gold kept for accents only (current menu marker, focus ring, badges).

## Install

- **APEX 23.1 to 25.x:** Shared Components > Export/Import > Import `dist/legacy/amc_style_royal.sql`
  (Component Export) into an app on Universal Theme. It adds the style to Theme 42 and uploads
  `amc-styles/amc-style-royal.css` as a Static Application File. Then pick it in Theme Roller or
  Shared Components > Themes > Universal Theme > Styles (Set as Current), or let users pick it when
  Customization is enabled.
- **APEX 26.1+ (APEXlang):** copy `dist/apexlang/shared-components/themes/universal-theme/styles/amc-royal.apx` and the static file, merge
  `dist/apexlang/static-files.snippet.apx`, and set `style.currentThemeStyle` in `theme.apx` to
  `@amc-royal` if it should be the default. Then run the apexlang gates.

Light style built on Vita for government and enterprise apps. The header is deep indigo with a thin gold rule beneath it, the page is warm ivory and regions are ivory-white with a fine border. The primary color is indigo (WCAG AA and AAA with white text). Gold is used only as an accent: the current menu marker, the focus ring and neutral badges. Uses the system sans-serif stack with confident weights. Works with every AMC component and template, which read the same --ut-* variables. Header and navigation refinements target Universal Theme classes and should be checked on a live page.

Status: validated offline (contrast, rules, apexlang formatter) and previewed on a Universal Theme mock page.
Not yet applied to a live APEX instance.
